sourceChecks.text: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの各候補箇所を原文と前後の系譜文脈で確認。

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Elhanan, son of Jaare-oregim
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Lead lines 114–115: identifies the 2 Samuel Elhanan and explicitly says 1 Chronicles 20:5 calls him Elhanan son of Jair and records Lahmi as Goliath’s brother; lines 119–123 discuss the textual difference.
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: 記事は歴代誌上20:5でエルハナンがラフミを殺したという形と、サムエル記の別表現を区別しています。
wikipediaReadEvidence.note: 実際の記事本文を読み、対象節との関係に限って根拠を記録。
